title: The resolved training job, as emitted by Job.to_dict()
description: The complete, validated description of one training run, after the registry ceiling has narrowed the manifest envelope. This document is embedded in the training result's provenance, so it is what a later reader uses to reconstruct the run.

key.description: The registry key selected via DIMER_PREPROCESSING_ARGS_JSON. This, not DIMER's Base Model field, is the authoritative runtime selector.

revision.description: An immutable commit SHA. Never a branch or tag — a job pinned to a moving ref is not reproducible.

effectiveBatchSize.description: Derived, and recorded because it is the number that actually governs the optimizer step — reading it off the two factors is a step a later reader should not have to take.

maxSequenceLength.description: Already clamped to the registry ceiling. The registry narrows the manifest envelope and never widens it.

$comment: datasetDir and outputDir are deliberately NOT part of this document, which is why additionalProperties is false rather than permissive. They are container-local mount points supplied by the platform, carry no meaning outside the Job, and this document is user-visible — paths are incidental infrastructure detail that should not leak into it.
